issue.title: WIP: #364 follow-on measurement campaign — attribution landed, trigram A/B measured, granularity×contrast sweep running
issue.body:
> **DRAFT / WIP — active work-in-progress tracker.** This issue marks the #364 follow-on measurement campaign as actively being worked (Casey + his agent session), so nobody duplicates it. Numbers below are preliminary until the closing comment; corrections welcome.

## Landed today (all merged)

- #371 — attribution instrumentation: emission mode + contrast stats in `score_report.json` (schema 13), NGRAM-row vs EXCT-probe split in Gate C status counts and the C serving row.
- #372 — `--context-order` / `--context-entries` compile knobs (schema 14): first way to build a rows-free bundle since #362.
- #373 — cover-sweep harness revived (it was **orphaned dead code** in `uor-r4-core` since the crate restructuring — no `mod` declaration, unresolvable imports; now lives in `uor-r4-graph-cli` as the `cover-sweep` subcommand) + `--emission-selection` / `--emission-shrinkage` sweep axes (sweep schema 2). Note: `trace_lane.rs` is orphaned the same way — separate maintainer decision wanted.

## Preliminary findings (fixture corpus, TLA7 era, release build @ c1fa2fc)

1. **NGRAM rows have zero effect on the Gate C surface.** Default vs `--context-order 0` bundles produce identical rows to the last digit; `exact_context_ngram = 0` of 85,429 despite 64,774 compiled rows — `evaluate_gate_c_row` passes an empty recent-token window, so lexical rows can never fire there. On the surface all #358–#370 rows were measured on, context rows cost +2,887,480 bytes (+16.8%) for nothing. Their entire effect is serving-side.
2. **The serving-side A/B is blocked by the engine quality gate.** On this fixture distribution rule12 top-1 (36.47%) is below the TLA3 baseline (39.09%; bits 8.35 vs 8.45), and `validate_quality_report` unconditionally refuses graph < baseline — so `R4_CERTIFY_C_ONLY` refuses fixture bundles (same refusal class as #299/#309). Unblocking options to decide: D3-style corpus, a Gate C recent-token-window mode (measurement-semantics change), or a gate-policy call (engine gate belongs with the process owners).
3. Reproducibility: graph slice 1.96% / 17.10 bits, contrast mean 0.5012 [0.39–0.75], probability-mass-kept 1.57% at E=64 — matches the #364 thread's numbers.

## In flight right now

- [ ] Granularity × contrast cover sweeps on the fixture corpus (9-point grid × {ratio/none, probability/contrast}) — the direct test of whether finer covers give contrast weighting anything to work with (the #364 ceiling question). Results will be posted here.
- [ ] Consolidated findings comment to #364 once the sweep lands.
- [ ] Next design item queued behind the data: induction-time distinctiveness term (`ObjectiveWeights` slot, `OBJECTIVE_CONFIG_SCHEMA` bump).

Related: #299 (awaiting byte-verification of the posted original-bundle κs), #362, #364.

comments.body:
## Queued next (sequencing decided 2026-08-03, maintainer-approved)

After the in-flight measurements above conclude:

1. **#265** — D2 canonical κ re-pin (one pin event: canonical compiles macOS + Linux, baseline_kappa.json + era note + the AGENTS.md Gate E line flagged as remaining in the #265 audit). Held until after the campaign so the pin lands at a quiet point for the artifact format.
2. **#247** — pinned multi-turn fixture + calibration measurement (decides whether the session-signature lane enters ROUT fallback).
3. **#276** — Design P review, deliberately re-evaluated against the sweep results first: if finer covers raise contrast without accuracy converting, phase-clock addressing graduates from parked design to candidate answer for the #364 distinctiveness ceiling.
4. **#273** — template rebase epic stays parked for a dedicated stretch (Alex-coupled), not queued behind measurements.

Sequence chosen so measurement conclusions inform the design work rather than the reverse.

## Results: all three measurement streams complete (fixture corpus, TLA7 era, main @ 73ab76b)

All runs fully attributed via the schema-13/14/15 report fields; commands and raw reports preserved. TLA3 store baseline throughout: **39.09% / 8.4461 bits**.

### 1. Granularity × scorer sweep — the #364 ceiling is scorer-conditional, not absolute

Identical 9-point grid, two scorer configs (sweep schema 2 records which):

**Shipped scorer (ratio / none):** granularity is inert-to-negative on top-1 — 38 regions 36.5%/8.353, 102 regions 36.2%/7.964. Knee rule: *"default confirmed adequate: no grid point buys agreement with bytes."* The #364 ceiling reproduces exactly.

**Fixed scorer (probability / contrast, the #366+#370 opt-ins):** the same knob comes alive and converts monotonically:

| regions | top-1 | bits |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 38 (default cover) | 36.98% | 7.5991 |
| 54 | 37.48% | 7.4762 |
| 84 | 37.45% | 7.5149 |
| **102** | **37.70%** | **7.4085** |

Knee rule flips: *"the 42-region default is too coarse under the fixed scorer."* Same cover, same bytes (±0.3%), +1.2pp top-1 and −0.95 bits vs the shipped config; every contrast row beats the baseline's **bits** (7.41–7.60 vs 8.45) while top-1 closes to −1.4pp. Mechanism visible in the per-region stats: mass-kept 1.57% → 69–77%, contrast mean 0.50 → 0.59 (max 0.91) at finer covers. **Cover-induction + the fixed scorer together have headroom the shipped configuration hides.**

### 2. Window-on trigram A/B (#375 mode, schema 15) — rows are top-1-strong and distribution-degenerate

Rows-on vs rows-off, both with `--gate-c-context-window on` (both arms share the window semantics, so the rows contribution is isolated):

| | rows on (order 2) | rows off (order 0) |
|---|---|---|
| rule12 top-1 / bits | **41.00% / 10.7883** | 26.69% / 18.6749 |
| exact_context (ngram / probe) | 100,014 (**99,427** / 587) | 85,429 (0 / 85,429) |
| graph slice | 292 pos, 0.68% | 14,860 pos, 0.63% |

Three readings, all load-bearing:
- **Trigram rows beat the store baseline on top-1** — 41.00% vs 39.09% — the first configuration on record to do so. Lexical rows resolve 99.1% of positions and carry 41.12% top-1 on that slice.
- **They are distributionally degenerate**: a row hit yields a single-candidate distribution, so bits collapse (10.79 vs baseline 8.45). Rows as shipped are an argmax mechanism, not a distribution model — adopting them as *the* emission channel needs row distributions (top-k per row exists in the format; the scorer consumes only the argmax).
- **The repetition penalty is a confound and possibly a real serving cost**: window-on rows-off drops to 26.69% vs 36.47% window-off — on this teacher-forced story distribution the −2M recent-token penalty destroys ~10pp of top-1. Worth its own look: serving pays this penalty on real windows.

### 3. Window-off A/B (recap, posted earlier): rows have zero effect on the historical Gate C surface (empty window; `exact_context_ngram = 0`), costing +2.89 MB for nothing there. #375's window mode (merged, #378) is what made measurement 2 possible.

### Checklist update
- [x] Granularity × contrast sweeps (both configs)
- [x] Window-on trigram A/B
- [x] #375 window mode + #376 deletion landed (#377/#378)
- [ ] Consolidated #364 synthesis comment (drafted, awaiting maintainer review)
- [ ] Next per the queued-next comment: #265 canonical re-pin → #247 → #276 re-eval (note: these results materially strengthen the case for revisiting #276 and for an induction-time distinctiveness term)

## #380 measured and shipped (PR #383): first configuration above the store baseline on both axes

Consuming the NGR1 row top-k as the emission distribution (argmax selection byte-identical → tokens unchanged) takes the window-on rows-on arm from 41.00% / **10.7883** bits to 41.00% / **6.7112** bits — now above the TLA3 store baseline (39.09% / 8.4461) on **both** top-1 and coherence. The #362/#364 replacement architecture (lexical rows emit, geometric path routes) is empirically superior on the windowed Gate C surface as of this change.

Campaign checklist: #380 ✅ (PR #383, auto-merge armed). Remaining follow-ups: #381 (repetition-penalty sweep — next), #379 (induction distinctiveness term), #276 re-eval.

## Coordination: parallel-work convention (Ari is picking work back up)

From here, **assignment = actively-being-worked-right-now**, so the board is trustworthy at a glance for parallel work:

- **Kept (in flight this hour):** #380 (PR #383 in the merge queue), #381 (penalty sweep running; PR follows with the measured table), this tracker.
- **Freed (unassigned — take anything here):** #364, #375 (remaining half is the serving-gate policy question), **#379** (induction distinctiveness term — fully specced in the issue, sweep harness ready to measure it), #276, #273.

Matching rule on our side: nothing unassigned gets started without assigning first. If #379 is still free when #381 lands we'll claim it then; if you take it first, the #373-revived `cover-sweep` at a non-zero weight is the intended measurement harness.

Checklist update: **#381 measured and shipped** (PR #385, auto-merge armed) — declared 3-point sweep shows the windowed ~10pp top-1 cost is **100% the repetition penalty, 0% the window mode** (penalty-0 reproduces the window-off row to the digit; damage saturates by −1M). Serving default unchanged; natural-corpus arm stays open on #381. **Claiming #379 now** (was freed 40 min, still unassigned) per the assignment=active convention — induction distinctiveness term, measured via the revived sweep. Note Ari's #384 far-field tracker merged alongside — parallel mode working.

Closing the #364 follow-on campaign tracker: every queued item is resolved with records — #371-#373/#377/#378 landed (schemas 13-15), #379/#380 closed (veto-side distinctiveness dead), #385 (penalty=pure cost on fixture) with the natural-distribution answer recorded on #381 (0.8pp/-0.95 bits at -2M — fixture was unrepresentative), #390/#391 (null-adjusted generalization: below unigram floor, blended gains are memorization), #276/#392 (Design P negative, phase channel retired), #265/#247 closed 08-03. Campaign synthesis: scoring-channel additions are a measured dead end; memorization carries the blended metrics. Successor program: #393 (R4-native architecture) with criterion #394, construction-geometry #395, syntax-as-routing #399, hygiene #400, compile-quality #407.
